newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-LONDON IRISH GET CASH FOR NEW PLAYERS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-LONDON IRISH GET CASH FOR NEW PLAYERS.

text.p: London Irish rugby union club are to receive a 1.5 million pounds sterling ($2.5 million) cash injection after members voted in favour of a friendly buy-out by a six-man business consortium on Friday.
Around 400 members met at Twickenham and backed the proposed 51 percent take-over by the businessmen, five of whom are long-standing members of the club.
The money will be made available immediately for much-needed additions to the London Irish squad with the understanding that more will be found if needed.
The club, which celebrates its centenary next season, narrowly avoided relegation last season after beating Coventry in a play-off.
Relegation to the second division would have been a financial disaster. It was felt that a buy-out was the only way to secure the club's long-term status in the top flight.
Club spokesman Michael Flatley said: "It is great news. We can now start to organise our playing structure and confidently look forward to next season with hope and free of debts."
